clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 5. The most expensive single call of the 16 scripts is the swap of set 1 script 67 at tick spacing 1 across most of the range. Per-transaction caps: Polygon 33,554,432 (EIP-7825 with 2^25 since Madhugiri, block 80,084,800), block limit 160M; Monad 30M per transaction, 150M per block; Tempo 30M per transaction inside a 500M block. No pool state an ordinary account can build makes a removal or a claim withdrawal need more gas than a transaction may carry, so there is no freeze.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Code: the swap loop condition at src/libraries/Pool.sol:344 exits when result.sqrtPriceX96 equals params.sqrtPriceLimitX96, so a large swap can be split with price limits. Pool.modifyLiquidity (src/libraries/Pool.sol:145-215) updates only tickLower and tickUpper, flips at most two bitmap bits, updates one position and clears at most two ticks; it has no loop over other ticks, so its gas does not grow with pool state an attacker builds. Chain: bor master params/protocol_params.go:32 sets MaxTxGas = 1 << 25 (33,554,432) and core/state_transition.go:374-379 rejects a gas limit above it once IsMadhugiri; params/config.go:442 sets the mainnet MadhugiriBlock to 80084800. Latest blocks queried now: Polygon publicnode bor v2.11.1-private block 97,940,381 gasLimit 160,000,000; rpc.monad.xyz Monad/0.16.7 block 125,310,087 gasLimit 150,000,000; rpc.mainnet.tempo.xyz tempo/v1.19.1-a9d6748 block 50,761,567 gasLimit 500,000,000. The Monad and Tempo 30M per-transaction caps were not re-fetched in this check.
